points.evidence: 2026-09-27 main read confirms primary loading still renders cut-profile-v2__skeleton

points.title: Align UserEditPage avatar/cover editing and preview with public profile view
points.evidence: 2026-09-27 fresh main audit: cover is clickable and has preview, but avatar itself is not clickable; avatar still relies on visible file input. EntityEditorShell provides view-like preview and anchored sections.

points.title: Role-specific visual identity and relational modules for producer/promoter/participant profiles
points.evidence: commit d7d52435a40591e38088e6ff04f587ffee81ee6a removes blue/purple/cyan/orange actor accents, decorative rgba/blur/gradient surfaces, adds solid black/graphite/red role treatment, focus-visible, >=44px badge targets and reduced-motion; CI status pending with no contexts

points.title: Audit ArtistViewPage role hierarchy, relational blocks and navigation consistency
points.evidence: audit confirms dedicated artist agenda/event cards, production origin navigation and Processing Indicator; global-format and decorative-transparency regressions split into W02-006/W02-007

points.title: Remove pt-BR hardcodes from ArtistViewPage date/time formatting
points.evidence: 2026-09-27 fresh main read: dateFormatter, timeFormatter and longDateFormatter still instantiate Intl.DateTimeFormat with pt-BR. Safe edit blocked because connector whole-file replacement cannot use truncated full-file response.

points.title: Remove decorative rgba gradient from artist cover hero
points.evidence: artist hero inline background still uses linear-gradient with rgba over cover, conflicting with opaque-surface/no-decorative-transparency requirement

points.title: Globalize profile-edit location model and labels
points.evidence: 2026-09-27 main audit: edit profile assumes Brazilian UF (2 chars), CEP and address semantics; change() uppercases/truncates uf to 2 chars. This structurally constrains worldwide profiles.

points.title: Make avatar media itself keyboard/click accessible for replacement
points.evidence: 2026-09-27 main audit: cover media is a button opening hidden picker, but avatar preview is a non-interactive div followed by file input; requirement says avatar and cover must be clickable.
